content: Standard leakage-smoke-test pattern for a feature pipeline: (1) build a feature frame from data truncated at date T, (2) build a second feature frame from the same raw data but with additional rows appended after T (i.e. more future data available), (3) assert that every feature value for dates <= T is byte-for-byte identical between the two frames. A complementary pattern: inject a synthetic column into the raw OHLCV data whose value is deterministically derived from a future date's price (a 'cheat' signal), run it through the feature pipeline, and assert the resulting feature frame does NOT contain that value at any row dated before the future date it was derived from. Implemented as a plain pytest test (pytest-only, no special leakage-testing library exists in this ecosystem).
